A: **Skill Knapsack / Failure Checkers** Skill Knapsack: fill two hours by new-skill per minute, covering distinct faults, fallback to best single demo. Failure Checkers: owner attempts diagnosis, different visitor checks it, electrician only fixes; failures written on cards carried to next table. Keep Failure Checkers. Ex: 12 chairs as three walk-in groups of four; toaster with frayed cord: owner proposes, neighbor checks plug vs element, electrician confirms; card records confusion for next group. Test: vs first-come watch-only Saturdays; give returners an unseen kettle fault to diagnose solo; checkers win if solo diagnoses double.
B: **Lease Lead / Barred Remix** Lease Lead: clock grants 15-min liveliness leases; holder plays bright, other drops to quiet ostinato; roles swap on quarter-hour; slot number is fencing token—if clocks drift, higher number wins. Barred Remix: synchronized 30-min supersteps ending in 3-min joint silence to rescramble crowd. Keep Lease Lead. Ex: east leads :00-:15 with singalong, west hums; then flip. Test: alternate Lease nights vs both-full nights; log minutes each case sits empty; Lease wins if dead-minutes fall without total coins falling.
C: **Log Rotation / Tiered Vault** Log Rotation: number each tape at drop-off, autoplay in log order, append intake and airing to ordered log, post nightly snapshot list; correct errors by re-airing next night, never rewriting. Tiered Vault: when over 3h, drop most-aired first, keep unplayed working set resident, prefetch same-donor tapes. Keep fused version. Ex: #47 folk song airs Tue 1am, logged; if skipped, replay Wed plus correction; giver checks #47 on posted list. Test: vs newest-first week; compare unaired count and max repeats; fused wins if unaired hits zero with lower repeats.
D: **Provenance Beam / Linked Keepsakes** Provenance Beam: tag each candidate piece with teller, use, date; keep pieces with most independent derivations, embed with labels. Linked Keepsakes: collect atomic crossing stories on cards, link related cards on library wall. Keep fused: seasonal meetings gather cards, vote with derivations. Ex: worn handrail section returns as new-bridge bench, plaque lists three commuters’ 1989, 2005, 2024 crossings with both event and telling dates. Test: vs council plaque; quiz daily crossers next season on what survives and why; fused wins if recall and ownership double.
